description: Adversarially audits multi-routine automation artifacts (cron/API routine libraries, scheduled-task decks, "routine cards") for cross-lane contamination, scheduled-task governance violations, and the structurally-empty-at-runtime defect — then splits them into lane-clean artifacts and rebuilds them from a single-source generator. Use whenever Kyle hands over a routine/automation artifact and says "audit this", "fresh adversarial pass", "keep them lane-specific", "make these lane-clean", "split by lane", "apply all fixes", or "rebuild the artifact" — even if he doesn't say "lane" or "governance". Also triggers on: routine cards audit, cron library review, automation deck audit, scheduled-task governance check, Loxihart vs FlashFusion bleed, lane contamination, n8n tenant collision, pipeline-vs-recognized-revenue, data-source guard, count-bug, generator rebuild, lane separation. PERSONAL/Loxihart context. NOT for app/codebase security audits (use code-auditor) and NOT for building a single new routine.
